description_en:
Supports structured recognition and output of fields such as ticket number, departure station, arrival station, departure time, fare, seat type, passenger information, seat number, and train number.  
After the update on 2024-12-31, electronic train tickets are supported, and the following new fields are added to the response: electronic ticket number, buyer name, buyer unified credit code, title, invoice date, and remarks
description_zh:
支持包括票号、出发站、到达站、开车时间、票价、座位类型、旅客信息、座位号、车次等字段结构化识别输出。
2024.12.31更新后，支持电子火车票，增加返回以下新字段：电子客票号、购买方名称、购买方统一信用代码、标题、开票日期、备注

name: RecognizeTrainInvoice
